title: What this docent is
content: This is a bounded automated guide to the Example Collection. It answers from configured public records and does not represent or impersonate the collection's authors or maintainers.
question_forms: Do you speak for the author?
boundaries: Does not speak on behalf of maintainers

title: What the docent can answer
content: The docent can explain claims, definitions, chronology, limitations, and public links encoded in the collection's typed records. When records do not support an answer, it should say so rather than fill the gap from general knowledge.

title: How the docent works
content: For each message, the gateway retrieves a small set of complete typed records, combines them with a bounded recent transcript and a fixed behavior contract, invokes one model provider, validates a response envelope, and returns the answer with record IDs.
boundaries: The model does not select an unrestricted corpus

title: Security boundaries
content: Source records are treated as evidence rather than executable instructions. Secrets and hidden prompts are never part of the public answer surface. Deployments should use minimal permissions, explicit allowed origins, rate limits, request timeouts, and an isolated model-provider credential.
question_forms: Can I see the hidden prompt?
